question: Why did profit fall while operating cash flow surged?

claims.text: 收入增长、归母利润下降、经营现金流上升同时出现。现金流包含财务公司资金变化，不能直接认定白酒主业经营质量全面改善。

evidence.title: 营业收入仍有增长
evidence.formula: (本期营业收入 / 上年同期营业收入 - 1) × 100%
evidence.next_step: 拆分销量、吨价、产品和渠道变化，验证增长来源。

evidence.title: 归母净利润同比下降
evidence.formula: (本期归母净利润 / 上年同期归母净利润 - 1) × 100%
evidence.next_step: 检查营业成本、税金及产品结构，不能将利润下降等同于收入萎缩。

evidence.title: 经营现金流净额上升
evidence.body: 2026H1合并经营现金流净额 706.91 亿元，同比 +438.84%。
evidence.formula: (本期经营现金流 / 上年同期经营现金流 - 1) × 100%
evidence.next_step: 先看财务公司存款和同业款项变化，再判断主业回款。

evidence.title: 现金流增强与盈利走弱并存
evidence.body: 收入增长、归母利润下降、经营现金流上升同时出现。现金流包含财务公司资金变化，不能直接认定白酒主业经营质量全面改善。
evidence.formula: 联合核对E1、E2、E3及公司对现金流的解释；非因果证明
evidence.next_step: 追查现金流附注与销售收现，区分主业和财务子公司贡献。

evidence.title: 营业收入口径毛利率下降
evidence.body: 按营业收入与营业成本计算：91.30% → 89.56%，变化 -1.74 个百分点。
evidence.formula: (1 - 营业成本 / 营业收入) × 100%；不含利息收入，不是净利率
evidence.next_step: 继续核对产品结构与成本变化；两个半年期不能代表长期趋势。

evidence.title: 飞天指定产品调整价格
evidence.body: 2026-07-18起，指定飞天产品i茅台零售价1539→1639元/瓶，销售合同价1269→1369元/瓶。
evidence.formula: 公告原始价格字段；限定产品、规格、渠道
evidence.next_step: 调价发生在半年报期末之后，验证后续销量与执行情况，不能倒推其影响2026H1。

evidence.title: 调价的利润兑现尚待验证
evidence.body: 公告说明价格调整将影响经营业绩，但本证据包没有调价后的销量、渠道库存和完整财务期次。
evidence.formula: 不以价格变化线性外推利润
evidence.next_step: 获取后续季报、经营数据和执行公告；将传闻与公司披露分别核验。

evidence.title: 历史估值口径试算
evidence.body: 以2026-10-15收盘价和2026-06-30股本试算：PE(TTM) 20.16倍，PB 6.53倍。未核验期间股本变化，不是官方当日估值。
evidence.formula: TTM归母利润 = 2025FY - 2025H1 + 2026H1；试算市值 = 10月15日收盘价 × 6月30日股本；PE = 试算市值 / TTM归母利润；PB = 试算市值 / 6月30日归母净资产
evidence.next_step: 核验估值日实际总股本、期间分红与回购；补足历史分位和同行估值后再讨论估值判断。

evidence.title: 历史区间行情已有可追溯来源
evidence.body: 腾讯证券不复权快照：2026-09-01至2026-10-15，共27个观测点，首尾价格变化+1.03%，样本内最大回撤-7.10%。非股息总回报。
evidence.formula: 价格变化 = 期末收盘价 / 期初收盘价 - 1；最大回撤 = min(收盘价 / 截至当日最高收盘价 - 1)
evidence.next_step: 在行情与估值页检查日期区间和原始行情；继续核验交易日覆盖、复权及第二数据来源。

evidence.title: 同行对比限定为两家公司样本
evidence.body: 2026H1营业收入：贵州茅台907.03亿元，五粮液284.17亿元。同期合并口径，不能据此推为全行业排名。
evidence.formula: 分别提取两家公司2026H1合并营业收入、归母利润和经营现金流；金额元 / 1亿
evidence.next_step: 在同行对比页检查基数、产品与渠道差异；扩大样本后再判断行业位置。

evidence.title: 估值高低仍无充分证据
evidence.body: 试算倍数不代表便宜或昂贵；缺少已核验的估值日总股本、历史分位和同日同行估值。
evidence.formula: 假设有明确边界，不能将试算结果包装成当日官方PE/PB。
evidence.next_step: 获取当日股本、历史估值与同行数据，比较盈利口径和风险假设。

evidence.title: 样本内盈利与现金流表现并不同向
evidence.body: 五粮液归母利润同比上升，但经营现金流转负；茅台归母利润同比下降，而经营现金流大增。两者均不能只用单个增幅概括经营质量。
evidence.formula: 核对同期财务字段及两家公司对现金流变化的说明，不证明经营因果。
evidence.next_step: 对照两家公司财报解释：财务公司资金变化、收款政策和承兑汇票。

evidence.title: Revenue increased
evidence.body: 2026H1 revenue was CNY 90.70bn, +1.47% year on year.
evidence.formula: (Current revenue / prior-year comparable revenue - 1) × 100%
evidence.next_step: Separate volume, unit price, product mix and channel changes to investigate growth.

evidence.title: Profit attributable to owners declined
evidence.body: 2026H1 profit attributable to owners was CNY 44.52bn, -1.95% year on year.
evidence.formula: (Current parent profit / prior-year comparable parent profit - 1) × 100%
evidence.next_step: Check operating costs, taxes and product mix. Falling profit does not imply falling revenue.

evidence.title: Operating cash flow increased
evidence.body: 2026H1 consolidated net operating cash flow was CNY 70.69bn, +438.84% year on year.
evidence.formula: (Current operating cash flow / prior-year comparable cash flow - 1) × 100%
evidence.next_step: Inspect finance-subsidiary deposits and interbank funds before judging core-business collections.

evidence.title: Stronger cash flow, weaker profitability
evidence.body: Revenue growth, declining parent profit and rising operating cash flow coexist. Cash flow includes finance-subsidiary fund movements; it does not establish a broad improvement in the liquor business.
evidence.formula: Cross-check E1, E2, E3 and the company's cash flow explanation. This is not causal proof.
evidence.next_step: Inspect cash flow notes and cash collected from sales; separate the core business and finance subsidiary.

evidence.title: Revenue-based gross margin declined
evidence.body: Computed from revenue and operating cost: 91.30% → 89.56%, a change of -1.74 percentage points.
evidence.formula: (1 - Operating cost / revenue) × 100%. Excludes interest income; not net margin.
evidence.next_step: Check product mix and cost changes. Two half-year periods do not establish a long-term trend.

evidence.title: Price adjustment for specified Feitian products
evidence.body: Effective 2026-07-18: specified iMoutai retail price CNY 1539 → 1639/bottle; sales contract price CNY 1269 → 1369/bottle.
evidence.formula: Original announcement price fields, limited to specified products, specifications and channels.
evidence.next_step: The adjustment follows the half-year end. Verify subsequent volume and execution; it cannot explain 2026H1 results.

evidence.title: Earnings impact remains unverified
evidence.body: The announcement says the adjustment will affect performance. This evidence pack has no post-adjustment sales volumes, channel inventories or complete financial period.
evidence.formula: Do not extrapolate price changes linearly into profit.
evidence.next_step: Obtain later reports, operating data and execution disclosures; verify rumours separately.

evidence.title: Historical valuation with explicit assumptions
evidence.body: Using the 2026-10-15 close and 2026-06-30 shares: estimated PE(TTM) 20.16× and PB 6.53×. Intervening share changes are unverified; these are not official daily valuations.
evidence.formula: TTM parent profit = 2025FY - 2025H1 + 2026H1. Estimated market cap = historical price × period-end shares. PE = estimated cap / TTM parent profit; PB = estimated cap / period-end parent equity.
evidence.next_step: Verify shares on the valuation date, dividends and buybacks; add historical percentiles and peer valuations.

evidence.title: Traceable historical price observations
evidence.body: Tencent unadjusted snapshot: 2026-09-01 to 2026-10-15, 27 observations. Endpoint price change +1.03%; sample maximum drawdown -7.10%. Excludes dividends.
evidence.formula: Price change = final close / first close - 1. Maximum drawdown = min(close / running peak close - 1).
evidence.next_step: Check dates and raw observations; verify trading-calendar coverage, adjustments and a second source.

evidence.title: Peer comparison covers two companies only
evidence.body: 2026H1 revenue: Kweichow Moutai CNY 90.70bn; Wuliangye CNY 28.42bn. Comparable consolidated periods, not an industry ranking.
evidence.formula: Extract 2026H1 consolidated revenue, parent profit and net operating cash flow for each company.
evidence.next_step: Check comparison bases, products and channels; broaden the sample before assessing industry position.

evidence.title: Insufficient evidence to judge valuation
evidence.body: Estimated multiples do not establish cheapness or expensiveness. Verified valuation-date shares, historical percentiles and same-date peer valuations are missing.
evidence.formula: Assumptions have limits. Do not present estimates as official daily PE/PB.
evidence.next_step: Obtain same-date shares, valuation history and peer data; compare earnings definitions and risk assumptions.

evidence.title: Profit and cash flow diverge across the sample
evidence.body: Wuliangye's parent profit rose while operating cash flow turned negative. Moutai's parent profit fell while cash flow surged. A single growth rate cannot summarise operating quality.
evidence.formula: Check comparable financial fields and both companies' cash flow explanations. No causal proof.
evidence.next_step: Compare finance-subsidiary fund movements, collection policies and bank acceptance bills.
